mapper.select: SELECT id, permit_no, access_request_id, vessel_id, company_id, valid_from, valid_to, qr_code_url, issued_by, issued_at, revoked, revoked_reason, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_visit_permit WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT vp.id, vp.permit_no, vp.access_request_id, ar.request_no AS access_request_no, vp.company_id, c.name AS company_name, COALESCE(ic.name, c.industry_other) AS industry_name, vp.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, vp.valid_from, vp.valid_to, vp.qr_code_url, vp.issued_by, vp.issued_at, vp.revoked, vp.revoked_reason, vp.revoked_at FROM tb_visit_permit vp LEFT JOIN tb_access_request ar ON ar.id = vp.access_request_id LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = vp.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = vp.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_code ic ON ic.group_code = 'INDUSTRY' AND ic.code = c.industry_code AND ic.active = 1 WHERE vp.id = #{id} AND vp.deleted = 0

SELECT vp.id, vp.permit_no, vp.access_request_id, ar.request_no AS access_request_no, vp.company_id, c.name AS company_name, COALESCE(ic.name, c.industry_other) AS industry_name, vp.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, vp.valid_from, vp.valid_to, vp.qr_code_url, vp.issued_by, vp.issued_at, vp.revoked, vp.revoked_reason, vp.revoked_at FROM tb_visit_permit vp LEFT JOIN tb_access_request ar ON ar.id = vp.access_request_id LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = vp.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = vp.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_code ic ON ic.group_code = 'INDUSTRY' AND ic.code = c.industry_code AND ic.active = 1 WHERE vp.permit_no = #{permitNo} AND vp.deleted = 0

SELECT vp.id, vp.permit_no, vp.access_request_id, ar.request_no AS access_request_no, vp.company_id, c.name AS company_name, COALESCE(ic.name, c.industry_other) AS industry_name, vp.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, vp.valid_from, vp.valid_to, vp.qr_code_url, vp.issued_by, vp.issued_at, vp.revoked, vp.revoked_reason, vp.revoked_at FROM tb_visit_permit vp LEFT JOIN tb_access_request ar ON ar.id = vp.access_request_id LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = vp.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = vp.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_code ic ON ic.group_code = 'INDUSTRY' AND ic.code = c.industry_code AND ic.active = 1 WHERE vp.access_request_id = #{accessRequestId} AND vp.deleted = 0 ORDER BY vp.issued_at DESC

SELECT vp.id, vp.permit_no, vp.access_request_id, ar.request_no AS access_request_no, vp.company_id, c.name AS company_name, COALESCE(ic.name, c.industry_other) AS industry_name, vp.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, vp.valid_from, vp.valid_to, vp.qr_code_url, vp.issued_by, vp.issued_at, vp.revoked, vp.revoked_reason, vp.revoked_at FROM tb_visit_permit vp LEFT JOIN tb_access_request ar ON ar.id = vp.access_request_id LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = vp.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = vp.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_code ic ON ic.group_code = 'INDUSTRY' AND ic.code = c.industry_code AND ic.active = 1
ORDER BY vp.issued_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_visit_permit ( permit_no, access_request_id, vessel_id, company_id, valid_from, valid_to, qr_code_url, issued_by, issued_at, revoked, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{permitNo}, #{accessRequestId}, #{vesselId}, #{companyId}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{qrCodeUrl}, #{issuedBy}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_visit_permit SET revoked = 1, revoked_reason = #{reason}, revoked_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(permit_no, 4) AS INT)), 0) FROM tb_visit_permit WHERE permit_no LIKE CONCAT('VP-', #{dateYmd}, '-%')
